name: The Sea Explorer
summary: Exploring the jaw-dropping US east coast by foot and by boat
description:
Set sail along Florida's sun-soaked coastline on a seven-day journey that blends easy beach days with time out on the open water. From the lively sands of Lummus Park Beach you'll island-hop south through the Keys, snorkeling vibrant coral reefs, kayaking calm turquoise shallows, and watching for dolphins along the way.
Evenings are spent in laid-back coastal towns like Islamorada, where fresh seafood and golden sunsets are part of the experience. By the time you reach the southern Keys you'll have explored the very best of the coast, both on foot and by boat.

name: The Forest Hiker
summary: Breathtaking hike through the Canadian Banff National Park
description:
Lace up your boots for five unforgettable days in the heart of the Canadian Rockies. This guided hike winds through Banff and Jasper National Parks, past glacier-fed lakes so blue they barely look real, towering pine forests, and high alpine meadows bursting with wildflowers.
With comfortable daily distances and plenty of stops to rest and take it all in, this trip is perfect for first-time hikers and seasoned nature lovers alike. Keep your camera ready, as elk, mountain goats, and the occasional bear are all part of the scenery.

name: The Snow Adventurer
summary: Exciting adventure in the snow with snowboarding and skiing
description:
Four action-packed days await on the legendary slopes of Aspen, Colorado. Whether you ski or ride, you'll carve through deep powder across Aspen Highlands and Beaver Creek, with steep terrain and tree runs to challenge even the most confident adventurers.
After a long day on the mountain, unwind in a cozy alpine lodge with a warm drink and good company beside the fire. This is a fast-paced trip built for those who love winter at its wildest.

name: The Park Camper
summary: Breathing in Nature in America's most spectacular National Parks
description:
Spend ten days under wide open skies on a camping adventure through the American Southwest's most spectacular national parks. Starting near Las Vegas, you'll trek the red cliffs of Zion, wander the sculpted walls of Antelope Canyon, stand on the rim of the Grand Canyon, and finish among the otherworldly Joshua trees.
Nights are spent around the campfire beneath a thick blanket of stars, far from the nearest city light. With moderate daily hikes and unforgettable scenery at every turn, this trip is a true celebration of the great outdoors.

name: The City Wanderer
summary: Living the life of Wanderlust in the US' most beatiful cities
description:
Discover the energy of America's greatest cities on this nine-day, coast-to-coast journey. Begin in the buzzing streets of New York, soak up the glamour and sunshine of Los Angeles, and finish among the hills and bridges of San Francisco.
From world-class museums and rooftop views to hidden cafes and lively local neighborhoods, every day brings something new to discover. Easygoing and packed with culture, it's the perfect trip for curious travelers and lovers of city life.

name: The Sports Lover
summary: Surfing, skating, parajumping, rock climbing and more, all in one tour
description:
This is the ultimate fourteen-day adrenaline tour for travelers who simply can't sit still. Surf the breaks at Point Dume, skate the iconic Venice bowls, leap from a plane over San Diego, raft the whitewater rapids of the Kern River, and scale the granite walls of Yosemite.
Designed for experienced and physically fit adventurers, this trip pushes your limits from the coast to the high mountains. Expect long, demanding days, expert instruction at every stop, and the kind of stories you'll be telling for years.

name: The Star Gazer
summary: The most remote and stunningly beautiful places for seeing the night sky
description:
Escape the glow of the city on a nine-day journey to some of the darkest, most remote corners of Utah and the surrounding deserts. By day you'll explore Natural Bridges, the dramatic curve of Horseshoe Bend, and the vast silence of Death Valley; by night the sky erupts with thousands of stars.
With expert guides pointing out planets, constellations, and the glowing band of the Milky Way, this trip is a quiet, awe-inspiring reminder of just how big the universe really is. Telescopes and warm layers are provided for every late-night viewing.

name: The Northern Lights
summary: Enjoy the Northern Lights in one of the best places in the world
description:
Chase one of nature's greatest spectacles on this three-day trip to Yellowknife, widely regarded as one of the best places on Earth to see the aurora borealis. As darkness falls, ribbons of green and violet light ripple and dance across the northern sky.
Warm viewing lodges, cozy late nights, and experienced guides give you the very best chance of witnessing the lights at their most vivid. Short, magical, and unforgettable, it's the perfect quick winter getaway.

name: The Wine Taster
summary: Exquisite wines, scenic views, exclusive barrel tastings,  and much more
description:
Savor five relaxed days among the rolling hills of California's Napa Valley. Visit celebrated estates like Beringer, Clos Pegase, and Raymond Vineyard for guided tastings, exclusive barrel samples, and behind-the-scenes tours of the cellars where each vintage is made.
Between vineyards you'll enjoy farm-to-table meals, scenic countryside drives, and golden sunsets over the vines. It's an easygoing, indulgent escape for anyone who loves great wine and beautiful views.
